description_en: Queries the forwarding rules that are configured for a specified listener
description_zh: 查询指定监听已配置的转发规则
kebab_example: aliyun slb describe-rules --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --load-balancer-id lb-bp1ca0zt07t9340000 --listener-protocol http --listener-port 90 --api-version 2014-05-15 --region cn-hangzhou
name: DescribeRules

parameters.help_en:
The ID of the region where the SLB instance is deployed.

You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/27584.html operation to query the most recent region list
parameters.help_zh:
负载均衡实例的地域ID。

您可以通过调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/27584.html接口查询地域ID
parameters.name: region_id

parameters.help_en: The ID of the SLB instance
parameters.name: load_balancer_id

parameters.help_en:
The frontend listener protocol that is used by the SLB instance.

> This parameter is required when listeners that use different protocols listen on the same port
parameters.help_zh:
负载均衡实例前端使用的协议。取值：

**TCP**：协议类型为TCP。

**UDP**：协议类型为UDP。

**HTTP**：协议类型为HTTP。

**HTTPS**：协议类型为HTTPS。

>相同端口存在不同协议监听时，此字段必填
parameters.name: listener_protocol

parameters.help_en:
The frontend listener port that is used by the Server Load Balancer (SLB) instance.

Valid values: **1 to 65535**
parameters.help_zh:
负载均衡实例前端使用的监听端口。

取值范围：**1~65535**
parameters.name: listener_port
